From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@bluewave.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Field Liaison Patterns & Rapid Reference Architectures — SI enablement plan

Team / Marta —

Thanks again for the call today. As discussed, I put together a concise plan we can use to get BlueWave consultants into hands-on readiness in four weeks, with two focused shadow weeks and an early certification gate. The goal is to reduce ramp time on typical integration projects by shipping a small set of Rapid Reference Architectures (RRA) and runbook templates they can reuse.

High-level plan (attachments):
- Week 0: sandbox access, baseline RRA review, enrollment in self-paced pre-work (2 hrs)
- Weeks 1–2: shadow rotations against two pilot integrations (search + summarization) — 3 half-days per week
- Week 3: partner-led lab + practical assessment (pass = certification)
- Ongoing: monthly office hours + escalation channel to Redwood field liaison

Requested next steps:
1) Marta: confirm sandbox admin list (I attached the current SI-shadow-schedule.xlsx).
2) BlueWave: identify two consultant leads for the shadow rotations by Friday.
3) Laura: can you confirm training slots and prework checklist?

Attachments included: RRA-reference-pack.pdf (4 x RRA templates), SI-shadow-schedule.xlsx (proposed calendar). I also dropped a calendar invite (.ics) for the kickoff — please accept and share any conflicts.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Sr. Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124

Rachel —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the concise plan. This looks exactly like what our services org needs. A few quick questions:
- Sandbox access: we have three engineers who need write access (marta@bluewave.com, jgreen@bluewave.com, srodriguez@bluewave.com). Can we get that provisioned by Wednesday?
- Certification gate: what are the success criteria for the practical assessment? Is it just the lab passing, or do you validate a small customer-facing demo?
- Doc link: can you add the shared RRA templates to a BlueWave-accessible Drive link? Some of our consultants travel and need offline copies.

We can nominate two leads by EOD Friday — tentatively Maria G and Jon R. Also, the proposed shadow schedule looks fine, but our timezone means mornings are better for us (EST).

Thanks — Marta
Marta Lopez | Head of Delivery, BlueWave Consulting
marta@bluewave.com | +1 212-555-1938
